title: nte-mod-authoring
summary: Create, adapt, cook, package, verify, and troubleshoot Neverness to Everness (NTE/异环) project-authored cosmetic mods using the standalone FModel → Blender → Unreal Engine 5.6 → NTE_Outfit_System/KawaiiPhysics workflow. Use for basic mesh or texture replacements, modular outfit items, custom hair/tails/ears with secondary motion, per-character detachable parts, UE cooking, and .pak/.ucas/.utoc packaging. Do not use this skill for raw IoStore package transplants or binary asset-graph migration.
